title: 第19章 绝世天才来自于天元武府的邀请第20章 武斗场连胜百场
content_zh:
“四十五牛之力！
？”
“五九极限！
？”
“三十六牛之力居然还不是他的极限？”
“真武境修炼出五九极限的四十五牛之力，就算是王室里的天之骄子，恐怕也不过如此。”
“这秦玄到底何方神圣，居然修炼出四十五牛之力？”
就算是天元武府的一众天才，包括柳师在内，同样眼泛惊色，不敢置信眼前这一幕。
真武境内，一般人极限往往只能够修炼出超过九牛之力。
一般超越了九牛之力，就能勉强称得上是武道天才了。
再厉害一些的天才，比如赵锋等，修炼出二十四牛之力，已经算是很厉害了。
如此前，秦玄所展现出的三十六牛之力，放眼在整个天元武府内，都绝对称得上是同境界的佼佼者，绝对能得到武府重视。
但现在，却发现，原来三十六牛之力还不是他的极限，如今直接呈现出四十五牛之力。
这是何等可怖的天赋。
这是何等可怖的肉身。
就连素来都神色平静的柳师，这一刻也无法继续保持下去，露出深深的惊色。
“这，就是你的攻击？”
秦玄转身，平静地看向近在咫尺却无法更进一步的李剑媚。
分明是平视，但李剑媚却感觉眼前这个少年如俯视一样，居高临下地看着自己，透着一股难以言喻的压迫感。
如同自己还是三岁小孩，面对着成年人一般！

轰！
秦玄出手，屈指一弹，周身环绕的四十五头蛮牛虚影没入手指中，顺着这一指弹出。
四十五牛之力爆发！
顿时间，李剑媚如遭雷击，整个人倒飞出去，重重地跌落在武斗擂台下，嘴角不断地溢血。
那柄精铁千锤百炼而成的秋水利剑，也节节崩断，成为一堆废铁。
满场皆寂！
依旧是一招，比起赵锋更强的李剑媚便败了。
所有人都像是看着神明一样，看着武斗擂台上中央的秦玄。
世间有人如神明！
被同伴搀扶起的李剑媚，远远看了一眼武斗擂台上，始终不动如山的秦玄，张口吐出了一大口鲜血，便是晕眩过去了。
这一刻，天元武府众天才弟子，再也没有了半点平日间的傲然之色了，因为擂台上的那个少年太强了，三次出手，三次击败了他们武府弟子。
而且一次比一次更强势粗暴。
柳师脚掌一跺，倩影飘然而上，落在武斗擂台上。
content_en:
“The power of forty-five oxen!
? "
“Fifty-nine limit!
? "
"The strength of thirty-six oxen is not his limit?"
"In the True Martial Realm, you can cultivate the strength of forty-five oxen at the limit of Wujiu. Even the proud son of the royal family may not be able to do more than this."
"Who is this Qin Xuan that can actually cultivate the strength of forty-five oxen?"
Even the geniuses of Tianyuan Martial Palace, including Master Liu, were also shocked and couldn't believe the scene before them.
In the realm of Zhenwu, most people can only cultivate more than nine oxen of power.
Generally, someone who has surpassed the power of Jiu Niu can barely be called a martial arts genius.
Even more powerful geniuses, such as Zhao Feng, can cultivate the power of twenty-four oxen, which is already considered very powerful.
The strength of thirty-six oxen displayed by Qin Xuan so far can definitely be regarded as the best in the same realm in the entire Tianyuan Martial Palace, and he can definitely be valued by the Martial Palace.
But now, he discovered that the power of thirty-six oxen was not his limit, but now he had the power of forty-five oxen.
What a terrifying talent this is.
What a terrifying body this is.
Even Master Liu, who had always looked calm, could no longer maintain his expression at this moment and showed a deep look of shock.
"Is this your attack?"
Qin Xuan turned around and looked calmly at Li Jianmei, who was very close but unable to go any further.
They were clearly looking at each other, but Li Jianmei felt as if the young man in front of her was looking down at her, looking at her condescendingly, with an indescribable sense of oppression.
It's like being a three-year-old child facing an adult!
boom!
Qin Xuan took action and flicked his finger. The phantoms of the forty-five wild bulls surrounding him disappeared into his finger and popped out along the finger.
The power of forty-five cows exploded!
Immediately, Li Jianmei felt as if she had been struck by lightning. She flew backwards and fell heavily under the martial arts ring, with blood pouring from the corners of her mouth.
The Qiushui sword, which was made of fine iron that had been tempered for thousands of times, also broke apart and became a pile of scrap metal.
The whole place was silent!
It was still one move, and Li Jianmei, who was stronger than Zhao Feng, was defeated.
Everyone looked at Qin Xuan in the center of the martial arts arena as if they were looking at gods.
There are people in this world who are like gods!
Li Jianmei, who was being helped up by his companions, glanced at Qin Xuan who remained motionless in the martial arts arena from a distance, opened his mouth and vomited out a large mouthful of blood, then passed out.
At this moment, the genius disciples of Tianyuan Martial Palace no longer looked as arrogant as usual, because the young man in the ring was too strong. He defeated their Martial Palace disciples three times in three attempts.
And each time it became more powerful and brutal.
Master Liu stamped his foot, and a beautiful figure floated up and landed on the martial arts arena.
